prompt: I want to improve the main editor screen's layout. Currently, we have buttons for tools and shapes everywhere. Can you look at our canvas and editor code, propose a modern Material 3 layout for tablets, and give me a task list for the programmer?

assertions.text: Performs an audit of the current canvas/layout files in lib/
assertions.evidence: The proposal analyzes EditorScreen in lib/main.dart and canvas widgets.

assertions.text: Proposes a clear Material 3 design layout optimized for tablets (e.g. NavigationRail or Sidebar)
assertions.evidence: Proposes a structured 2-column sidebar layout utilizing NavigationRail/NavigationDrawer.

assertions.text: Discusses tablet/stylus usability considerations specifically for ultrasound examination environments
assertions.evidence: Mentions low-light room constraints and minimum 48x48 dp touch target sizes for stylus.

assertions.text: Provides a developer specification with a task list and file list (using [MODIFY] and [NEW])
assertions.evidence: Contains a structured task list with [MODIFY] main.dart and [NEW] widgets.
